name: Deep Layers
description: A cross-section block of the ground in Three.js, with a tiny house and trees on top and stacked layers of soil, clay, rock and glowing hot rock below. A white drill line pushes down while the camera dives with it.
best_use_cases: Layered earth, drilling and depth explainers
style: 3D cross-section: stacked Three.js boxes in believable material colours (grass green, soil brown, sand, grey rock, dark granite, glowing orange heat), a small surface scene on top, a thin white drill with a glowing yellow tip, dark mono layer labels with real depths, Anton headlines with a yellow second line.
